49	    """The step loop: act for every team, then each learning team learns from its Transition."""
50	    learners = learning_teams(settings)
51	    spec = EvalSpec(settings.name, settings.seed, team=learners[0], n_games=settings.eval_games)
52	    env = make_env()
53	    rng = np.random.default_rng(settings.seed)

57	    active = _all_active(obs)
58	    for step in range(settings.steps):

62	        result = _step_and_learn(env, agents, learners, obs, active=active)
63	        if result.terminated or result.truncated:

66	            active = _all_active(obs)
